Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace `__get_validators__` with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` returning `core_schema.no_info_plain_validator_function(cls.validate)`. Import `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`; this keeps `PostCode.validate` responsible for coercion, normalization, and validation without using the deprecated hook.

Replace the `PostCode` subclass and its `__get_validators__` hook with a `PostCode = Annotated[str, BeforeValidator(validate_post_code)]` alias. Move the existing normalization and validation logic into `validate_post_code`, returning the normalized string, and import `Annotated` and `BeforeValidator`.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Import `Field` from `pydantic` and declare `key: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")` so Pydantic tries `int` first and coerces numeric strings.
Add a `@field_validator("key", mode="before")` that converts strings matching an integer representation with `int(value)`, returning other values unchanged.
Set `model_config = ConfigDict(coerce_numbers_to_str=True)` on `Label` (import `ConfigDict` from `pydantic`) so numeric SKU inputs are converted to strings during validation.
Add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` that converts integer SKU inputs to strings before validation, leaving other input types unchanged.
In `from_sensor`, pass `units=int(reading)` to `StockLevel` so fractional sensor readings are truncated toward zero before validation.
Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_validator("units", mode="before")` that returns `int(value)` for numeric inputs, so fractional readings are truncated before the `units: int` field is validated.
Replace the `parse_obj_as` import with `TypeAdapter`, then validate rows using `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)` in `load_users`.
Replace the deprecated `parse_obj_as` call with a Pydantic v2 `RootModel` for `list[User]`, and return `Users.model_validate(rows).root` from `load_users`.

In changed_fields, dump the validated patch with exclude_unset=True and return the sorted keys: return sorted(ProfilePatch(**raw).model_dump(exclude_unset=True)).
Import `field_serializer` from `pydantic` and add a `@field_serializer("price")` method on `Quote` that returns `float(value)`. This makes `model_dump(mode="json")` emit `price` as a JSON number.

Change `publish` to call `json.dumps(q.model_dump(mode="python"), default=float)`. The JSON encoder will convert the `Decimal` price to a numeric float instead of Pydantic's JSON-mode string representation.
Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_serializer("started", when_used="json")` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This makes UTC datetimes serialize with `+00:00` instead of `Z`.

Add a `@model_serializer(mode="wrap", when_used="json")` that calls the handler, then sets the returned mapping's `"started"` value to `self.started.isoformat()` before returning it. This preserves the `+00:00` offset in JSON output.
